commands.shard_a_W_reference:
cd <local-path>
mkdir -p results/phase4/wb/logs
for k in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do
  OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
  nohup env/.venv_pilot/bin/python lib/p4_run_wb.py --actor shard_a --shard "$k" --nshards 8 \
    > "results/phase4/wb/logs/shard_a_proc${k}.stdout.log" 2>&1 &
done
wait

commands.post_both_actors_join_statistics:
cd <local-path>
OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 env/.venv_pilot/bin/python - <<'POSTFREEZE'
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
r=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(r/'lib'))
from p4_contracts import require_frozen
import p4_collect as collect,p4_statistics as statistics
require_frozen()
rows=collect.assemble(strict=True)
records=json.loads((r/'results/phase4/COHORT_MANIFESTS.json').read_text())['records']
result=statistics.run_statistics(rows,cohort_manifest=records,reference_rows=None,official=True)
collect.write(rows,r/'results/phase4/primary_rows.csv')
(r/'results/phase4/statistics.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
POSTFREEZE

resources.historical_proposal_10_per_actor: select supported8/actor from actual integration runbook to leave8logical CPUs for system/model

row_schema.execution_guard: official=True calls require_frozen; explicit complete cohort manifest and actual reference receipts required
row_schema.reference_file_contract: source_phase/case_id/reference_path -> JSON pairs[pair].E_point[lead-1], complete 30-day vector; raw-byte hash receipt

statistics_signature: (rows, n_bootstrap=None, seed=None, draws=None, *, cohort_manifest=None, reference_rows=None, official=True)
reference_rows_reason: p4_collect already joins actual reference JSON E_point with path/raw-byte SHA/status receipts

resumability.W_reference: tf_input/protocol/driver SHA plus every output SHA, reference_status ok and truth_eval_ok; same command recomputes incomplete cases
resumability.model: exclusive lifetime flock; actor chunks validated by run fingerprint/query IDs; same actor command resumes
resumability.generation: once after freeze and before actors; never rerun during active execution
